# Diqto Voice

> Voice translation for meetings. Published by DIQTO SAS, France. / Traduction vocale pour les réunions. Édité par DIQTO SAS.

## Product information

Diqto Voice is an application for Windows and Mac, presented for use with Teams, Zoom, Google Meet and Webex. It is designed to let people speak their own language while the other person stays in their usual meeting application.
Public downloads, purchases and waiting-list sign-ups are not open on this website. No language-count claim, public pricing, compliance certification or performance guarantee is published here.
